function.name: thermodynamics_calc_gas_pressure

That seems ambiguous: maybe they want to calculate the pressure increase? Or the amount of gas? The phrase "產生多少氣體" could mean "how much gas will be produced" but we have a closed chamber with gas inside. Maybe they want to know the pressure change due to heating. The function thermodynamics_calc_gas_pressure calculates gas pressure in a closed chamber due to heating. So we should call that function with volume=2, initial_temperature=25, final_temperature=100, initial_pressure default (standard atmospheric pressure). Then we can provide the resulting pressure.
